name: Wortris
summary:
Wortris is a browser-based word puzzle game built for Twitch chat. Streamers start a level on their channel, and their viewers play together by typing words of four or more letters into chat. Every word found in the letter grid marks its letters. Completed rows an columns vanish, new letters move in, and each level gets a little harder.

Viewers can play without signing up or installing anything. Players who log in with Twitch can track their points and achievements across all channels, and both players and channels compete in weekly, monthly and all-time rankings. Logged-in players can also play solo. The game is available in German and English.
